notes.title: PATCH 1.03
notes.notes: Colorblind support added to The Maestro.

notes.title: PATCH 1.02
notes.notes:
Fixed some cutscene and SFX volume balance.
Fixed a missing song loop on a boss fight.
Added some SFX.

Fixed missing death count on a boss fight.

Added the [NORMAL] achievement if you beat the game on [HARD]
Fixed a transparent / forsenCD platform.
Small hitbox fix.

Fixed the occasional bug where it feels like playing as an ice skater and sliding all over the map.

notes.title: PATCH 1.01
notes.notes:
- Added an additional life to Normal mode.
- On hydra fight, ELEG pull rate reduced.
- Volume fixes
- Hobo fight small nerf, so snus attack doesn't repeat.
